texts.title: Business Portal
texts.tagline: Your entire business, powered by Coins.
texts.description:
The control center for every peso, payout,
and trade moving through Coins.
texts.who: Operations, finance, and product teams who need full visibility and control across every Coins product without writing a single line of code.

what:
One dashboard for QR PH,
WebPay, VAs, payouts, and trading.
Every transaction, wallet, and partner in a single view.
Roles, KYB, reporting, and webhook setup built in.
